description: List transactions for your org with optional filters. Examples: find ~$5k payment to Acme last month: { period: 'lastMonth', memo: 'Acme', minAmount: '4500', maxAmount: '5500', direction: 'outbound' }; all inbound activity this year on Base: { chainId: 8453, period: 'thisYear', direction: 'inbound' }; specific transaction by memo with explicit dates: { memo: 'Q1 payroll', startDate: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z', endDate: '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z' }; look up a transaction by its user-op hash returned from 'transactions sign': { userOpHash: '0x1dfe…dcf' }; look up an on-chain transaction by hash: { transactionHash: '0xabc…def', chainId: 8453 }. Each row has a dataType and one object with its details. 'transaction' rows have transactionData: types, source, timestamps, failureReason, revertReason, usdNetValue, gasPaidBy, recipients and raw per-operation metadata. 'merkleTransaction' rows are proposals that run on several networks, such as a signer change. Their top-level chainId, transactionHash and userOpHash are null; read merkleTransactionData.chainTransactions for each network's status and hashes. 'assetTransfer' rows have assetTransferData: token address, symbol, decimals, the raw amount in base units, usdValue, from and to. Older API versions return rows without dataType or these objects.

account.description: Filter by smart account address. Single address or comma-separated list (e.g. '0xa…,0xb…'). Results union across all listed accounts.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. You MUST replay the same filter values used on the request that produced this cursor.

direction.description: Filter by money flow. 'inbound' returns only inbound asset transfers (excludes splits-initiated transactions, which are always outbound). 'outbound' returns splits transactions plus outbound asset transfers. Omit for both.

endDate.description: EXCLUSIVE upper bound on transactionTime. ISO 8601. '2026-04-01' does NOT include April 1. Use 2026-04-02 to include April 1.

maxAmount.description: Inclusive upper bound on the absolute USD value. Same format as minAmount. Excludes transactions with no resolved USD price.

memo.description: Case-insensitive substring search across transaction and asset-transfer memos. Min 3, max 500 chars. Most efficient combined with --account, --chainId, or a date range.

minAmount.description: Inclusive lower bound on the absolute USD value. Positive decimal string (e.g. '1500.50'). Sign-agnostic — '1500' matches both +$1500 and -$1500. Excludes transactions with no resolved USD price.

period.description: Date range shorthand resolved in your local timezone. Mutually exclusive with --startDate / --endDate. Valid values: thisWeek, thisMonth, thisYear, lastWeek, lastMonth, lastYear, last30Days, last90Days, last6Months. Omit for all time.

startDate.description: Inclusive lower bound on transactionTime. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD interpreted as local-midnight, then converted to UTC).

transactionHash.description: Filter by on-chain transaction hash (0x-prefixed, 32 bytes). Matches splits-initiated transactions and asset transfers in your org. Combine with --chainId to disambiguate the same hash across chains.

userOpHash.description: Filter by ERC-4337 user-operation hash (0x-prefixed, 32 bytes). Returns 0 or 1 result. Only splits-initiated transactions have a userOpHash; asset-transfer rows are excluded when this filter is set. Use this to look up a transaction submitted via 'transactions sign --submit' from the returned userOpHash.

workspace.description: Workspace alias to run this command in (see `splits auth workspaces`). Overrides SPLITS_WORKSPACE and the active workspace.

name: transactions_list
